metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 1988 · Cocktail
metas.description: A talented New York City bartender takes a job at a bar in Jamaica and falls in love.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · M4M: Motive for Murder
metas.description: Hyderabad is on edge as a serial killer stages murders as famous paintings. ACP Krishna and journalist Radha investigate, uncovering links to a student and a principal, racing to stop the next planned killing.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1978 · Inek Saban
metas.description: A poor grocery owner becomes a popular goalkeeper.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2021 · Come from Away
metas.description: 7,000 passengers are stranded after the 9/11 terrorist attacks in a small town in Newfoundland, where they were housed and welcomed. Filmed live on stage at the Gerald Schoenfeld Theater in New York City.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wicker
metas.description: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

metas.name: 2026 · The Cycle
metas.description: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Maruva Tarama
metas.description: At a Goa restaurant, Anvi meets a naval officer for arranged marriage talks. Though beautiful and from a wealthy family, she hides a secret - her heart belongs to another. She declines his proposal.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2017 · Columbus
metas.description: A Korean-born man finds himself stuck in Columbus, Indiana, where his architect father is in a coma. The man meets a young woman who wants to stay in Columbus with her mother, a recovering addict, instead of pursuing her own dreams.

metas.name: 2026 · Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · Garividi Lakshmi
metas.description: A gifted folk singer from North Andhra rises to fame through her captivating voice and Burra Katha performances, only to mysteriously disappear at the height of her popularity. Years later, a man sets out to unravel the mystery. What happened to Garividi Lakshmi?

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1966 · It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · Passenger
metas.description: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger won't stop until it claims them both.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1961 · The Misfits
metas.description: A divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Intern
metas.description: A story about what happens when Sun-woo, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

metas.name: 2026 · Wildwood
metas.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.

metas.name: 2026 · You+Me - Against the World
metas.description: Alma Lancaster, conceals her filmmaking ambitions from her rich family who believe she's in law school. She falls for rebel Vadim Arcadi, while creating a student film. Someone observes, poised to reveal secrets that could destroy...

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2014 · Leviathan
metas.description: In a Russian coastal town, Kolya is forced to fight the corrupt mayor when he is told that his house will be demolished. He recruits a lawyer friend to help, but the man's arrival brings further misfortune for Kolya and his family.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2014 · When Marnie Was There
metas.description: Anna, a shy 12-year-old girl, is sent to spend time with her aunt and uncle who live in the countryside, where she meets Marnie. The two become best friends. But Anna gradually discovers that Marnie is not quite who she appears to...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Just Play Dead
metas.description: A criminal plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmaneuver each other in a deadly battle of wits.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Clayface
metas.description: Rising Hollywood star Matt Hagen descends into a horrifying revenge-filled monster when scientific ambition strips him of his identity and humanity.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Udta Teer
metas.description: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2026 · It's A Medical Miracle
metas.description: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2025 · Gondhal
metas.description: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.
